name: ごはんの種類と量や別添えを指定する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE Japanese Lighthouse rice type/quantity/side component LH19-0007 on pure white canvas, compact portrait composition.
Reference hierarchy: image1 ORIGINAL Chipotle source has highest authority for precise no-rice circle/slash glyph, control geometry/proportions, divider anatomy, alignment and spacing. Use rice region only, no navigation/beans/add-to-bag. Image2 native Japanese mock is SECONDARY content/layout guide; improve rough substitute details from source. Image3 approved Lighthouse style guides white rounded surfaces, fine neutral boundary and restrained shadow only.
Content order exactly: compact section heading 「ごはん」; thin neutral divider; white rice original food photograph at left, 「白米」 bold label and 「210 kcal」 regular secondary at right. Preserve original rice-photo arrangement, colors and crop, no invented rice/bowl. Under this row preserve Japanese mock label 「玄米の量」 describing the horizontally expanded quantity options. Four equal adjacent white neutral-outline segments, labels exactly 「通常」「少なめ」「多め」「別添え」. Source shows no active/highlighted segment, so do not invent selected state. Keep each target readable and usable; no green fill without actual selection. Bottom row original circle-with-diagonal-slash icon in coherent slate #526173, then 「ごはんなし」 label and 「0 kcal」 metadata. Match ORIGINAL glyph circle/slash thickness and centering, do not copy rough mock icon. No additional icon needed.
Typography locked Meiryo with compact established Japanese roles, regular body14/24, metadata12/16, heading20/28 only if appropriate to established role, tracking0. Main text #1D1D1D, supporting slate, secondary #6E6E6E. This unselected informational/control state has no primary committed action, so no arbitrary brand CTA or accent; outer card white with restrained fine border/shadow and modest roundness. Preserve original neutral state. All text visible, no clipping, no hidden brown-rice photo reconstruction, no invented amounts or green selected option, no broad mint or decorative graphic.
reviewNotes: 原本とモック・独立編集状態を実見。白米210kcal、玄米の量、通常／少なめ／多め／別添え、未選択状態、ごはんなし0kcalと禁止円の形を確認。中立状態に不要な緑を追加しない。写真の再構成差と玄米の量ラベルがRegularより太い点を要修正。所有者承認・編集可能性・注文連動は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
